facts.business: The company operates in the textile and fabric sector, engaged in manufacturing, processing, buying, selling, importing, exporting, distributing and dealing in yarn, fibers, fabrics, textiles, garments, industrial fabrics and other allied textile products.
key_risks: Market demand and price volatility in the textile and fabric sector
Competitive pressures and fluctuations in trading margins
Risk arising from continued losses and erosion in net worth
